---
title: "Prasanga Paudel | Data Analysis Portfolio"
---

<style>
.quarto-title-block { display: none; }

/* =========================================================
   SPLIT PORTFOLIO LANDING PAGE
   ========================================================= */

.portfolio-page {
  margin: -2rem -1rem -3rem;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #e8edf1;
  color: #182027;
}

.portfolio-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

.split-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(360px, 42%) minmax(0, 58%);
  min-height: calc(100vh - 60px);
}

/* =========================================================
   LEFT SIDE — INTRO / ABOUT
   ========================================================= */

.intro-panel {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  height: 100vh;
  min-height: 760px;
  padding: 5rem clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
  background: #dce3e8;
  border-right: 1px solid #c3ccd3;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.intro-kicker {
  color: #66737e;
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.intro-panel h1 {
  margin: 1.5rem 0 0;
  color: #172027 !important;
  font-size: clamp(4rem, 7vw, 7.5rem);
  line-height: .82;
  letter-spacing: -.065em;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.intro-role {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  max-width: 520px;
  color: #53616c;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.intro-facts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 0;
  margin-top: 2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #b9c4cc;
  border-left: 1px solid #b9c4cc;
}

.intro-fact {
  min-height: 105px;
  padding: 1rem;
  border-right: 1px solid #b9c4cc;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #b9c4cc;
}

.intro-fact-label {
  color: #73808a;
  font-size: .65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.intro-fact-value {
  margin-top: .5rem;
  color: #26323a;
  font-size: .85rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.intro-links {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .7rem;
}

.intro-link {
  padding: .7rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #aebac3;
  color: #26323a !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  font-size: .76rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  transition: .2s ease;
}

.intro-link:hover {
  background: #26323a;
  color: #f4f6f8 !important;
  border-color: #26323a;
}

/* =========================================================
   RIGHT SIDE — PORTFOLIO NAVIGATION
   ========================================================= */

.explore-panel {
  padding: 4rem clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4.5rem) 5rem;
  background: #f4f6f7;
}

.explore-header {
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.section-label {
  color: #7a8791;
  font-size: .68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.section-title {
  margin: .5rem 0 0;
  color: #1b252c !important;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -.045em;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.section-description {
  max-width: 620px;
  margin: 1rem 0 0;
  color: #68757f;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* =========================================================
   LANGUAGE CARDS
   ========================================================= */

.language-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}

.language-card {
  min-height: 245px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  background: #e5eaed;
  border: 1px solid #d0d8de;
  color: #1b252c !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition: .22s ease;
}

.language-card:hover {
  background: #dce3e8;
  border-color: #aebac3;
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.card-number {
  color: #7a8791;
  font-size: .68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
}

.language-name {
  margin-top: 2.5rem;
  color: #182027 !important;
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -.035em;
}

.language-description {
  margin: .5rem 0 0;
  max-width: 250px;
  color: #697680;
  font-size: .82rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.card-arrow {
  align-self: flex-end;
  color: #34424c;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
}

/* =========================================================
   PROJECT CARDS WITH PLACEHOLDER IMAGES
   ========================================================= */

.projects-header {
  margin-top: 5rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.project-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}

.project-card {
  min-height: 300px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  background: #202a31;
  color: #fff !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  border: 1px solid #cbd4da;
}

.project-image {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  opacity: .72;
  transition: transform .35s ease, opacity .35s ease;
}

.project-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12,18,23,.08) 20%, rgba(12,18,23,.88) 100%);
}

.project-card:hover .project-image {
  transform: scale(1.06);
  opacity: .82;
}

.project-content {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 2;
  left: 1.4rem;
  right: 1.4rem;
  bottom: 1.4rem;
}

.project-tag {
  font-size: .63rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .15em;
  opacity: .75;
}

.project-card h3 {
  margin: .55rem 0 .35rem;
  color: #fff !important;
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.project-card p {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 430px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
  font-size: .8rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.project-arrow {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 3;
  top: 1.2rem;
  right: 1.2rem;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
}

/* =========================================================
   BOTTOM NOTE
   ========================================================= */

.explore-footer {
  margin-top: 4rem;
  padding-top: 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #d1d9de;
  color: #77848d;
  font-size: .78rem;
}

/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 950px) {
  .split-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .intro-panel {
    position: relative;
    height: auto;
    min-height: auto;
    padding: 4rem 2rem;
  }

  .intro-panel h1 {
    font-size: clamp(4rem, 14vw, 7rem);
  }

  .explore-panel {
    padding-top: 4rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .intro-panel,
  .explore-panel {
    padding-left: 1.25rem;
    padding-right: 1.25rem;
  }

  .language-grid,
  .project-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .intro-facts {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
</style>
